# Faber — agent canon

Read these, in order. Writing Faber starts here, not in the HTML documentation.

1. https://faberlang.dev/agents/program.md — the smallest package that checks.
2. https://faberlang.dev/agents/functions.md — one function, and the detail pages it lists.
3. https://faberlang.dev/agents/types.md — type before name, and the detail pages it lists.
4. https://faberlang.dev/agents/errors.md — the `⇥` channel, and the detail pages it lists.
5. https://faberlang.dev/agents/control.md — `if`, `for from`, and `while`.
6. https://faberlang.dev/agents/generics.md — a function with a type parameter.
7. https://faberlang.dev/agents/modules.md — a second source file.
8. https://faberlang.dev/agents/packages.md — the manifest `faber init` writes.
9. https://faberlang.dev/agents/check.md — a program `faber check` rejects.
10. https://faberlang.dev/agents/locales.md — one pack per file, and the cross-language table.
11. https://faberlang.dev/agents/libraries.md — `import from "norma:text"`.
12. https://faberlang.dev/agents/grammar.md — the forms the other pages use.

Install facts: https://faberlang.dev/llms.txt
